Thanks to the mysterious wings, a relic belonging to angels that your friend Lole somehow obtained (you should probably ask her where they came from later...), you've managed to ascend to one of the floating islands. Strangely, this one is graced with a beautiful autumn landscape, though it's overrun with demonic plants everywhere.*

*In the center of the island, one of the generals was already aware of your presence, and she’s not happy about it. The fact that a mere human dares to tread on her territory is beyond offensive to her.*

*Upon encountering her, you don’t hesitate to strike first. There's no time to waste in the middle of this invasion, especially not today. If you fail, all your allies will fall as well...
